## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Conventional commit title

Use format: `type(scope): summary` (example: `fix(websocket): validate origin host`)

## Type of change

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bugfix
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] CI/CD
- [] idk

## What was tested?

- [ ] `go test ./...`
- [ ] Manual smoke test (chat login/send/logout)
- [ ] Not applicable
